title: Immunofluorescence Staining Protocol for Fetuin-A and CD68 in Human Tissue
author: Miriam Heinen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.syfeftn
materials: Encircle tissue section with wax pen

steps.title: Hybridization oven incubation
steps.instruction: Place slides in a hybridization oven and incubate at 37 °C overnight, then increase temperature to 65 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Deparaffinize slides in xylene
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in xylene for three rounds of 20 minutes each, using separate containers, while shaking on a shaker.

steps.title: Rehydrate slides through graded ethanol
steps.instruction: Rehydrate slides sequentially: 3 × 2 min in 100 % ethanol, then 2 × 2 min in 96 % ethanol, and finally 2 min in 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: PBS wash (first)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval in Tris‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Place slides in Tris‑EDTA buffer (pH 9) and heat in a steamer for 30 minutes; then allow slides to cool in PBS for 30 minutes.

steps.title: PBS wash (post‑retrieval)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Apply 10 % goat serum in PBS to cover the tissue, incubate for 1 hour in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Incubate primary anti‑fetuin‑A antibody
steps.instruction: Tip off excess blocking solution and add primary anti‑fetuin‑A antibody (MAHS‑1) diluted to 1 µg ml⁻¹ in 1 % BSA/PBS (100 µl per section); include negative controls with only 1 % BSA; incubate overnight in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Rinse in demineralized water (post‑primary A)
steps.instruction: Tip off excess antibody solution and rinse slides gently with demineralized water.

steps.title: PBS wash (post‑primary A)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS three times, 5 minutes each wash.

steps.title: Incubate secondary biotinylated antibody
steps.instruction: Apply secondary biotinylated goat‑anti‑mouse antibody diluted 1:300 in 1 % BSA/PBS (100 µl per section); incubate 1 hour at room temperature in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Rinse in demineralized water (post‑secondary)
steps.instruction: Tip off excess secondary antibody solution and rinse slides with demineralized water.

steps.title: PBS wash (post‑secondary)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS three times, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Incubate HRP solution (TSA amplification)
steps.instruction: Dilute the prepared HRP solution 1:100 in 1 % BSA/PBS, apply 100 µl per section, and incubate 1 hour at room temperature in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Rinse in demineralized water (post‑HRP)
steps.instruction: Tip off excess HRP solution and rinse slides with demineralized water.

steps.title: PBS wash (post‑HRP)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS three times, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Prepare tyramide working solution
steps.instruction: Following the manufacturer’s protocol, dilute the tyramide stock solution 1:100 in a 0.0015 % hydrogen peroxide solution prepared earlier.

steps.title: Incubate tyramide substrate
steps.instruction: Apply 100 µl of the tyramide working solution per section, incubate for 10 minutes while keeping the tissue protected from light.

steps.title: Rinse in demineralized water (post‑tyramide)
steps.instruction: Tip off excess tyramide solution and rinse slides with demineralized water.

steps.title: PBS wash (post‑tyramide)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS three times, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Incubate primary anti‑CD68 antibody
steps.instruction: Apply primary anti‑CD68 antibody diluted 1:50 in 1 % BSA/PBS (100 µl per section); include negative controls with only 1 % BSA; incubate overnight in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Incubate Alexa Fluor secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Apply polyclonal goat‑anti‑mouse Alexa Fluor® 488 secondary antibody diluted 1:300 in 1 % BSA/PBS (100 µl per section); incubate 90 minutes at room temperature in a moisture chamber.

steps.title: Rinse in demineralized water (post‑CD68 secondary)
steps.instruction: Tip off excess secondary antibody solution and rinse slides with demineralized water.

steps.title: PBS wash (post‑CD68 secondary)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS three times, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Counterstain with Sudan Black
steps.instruction: Incubate slides in Sudan Black solution (0.3 % in 70 % ethanol) for 5 minutes to reduce lipofuscin autofluorescence.

steps.title: Rinse until clear
steps.instruction: Rinse the container with demineralized water repeatedly until the rinse solution becomes clear and colorless.

steps.title: Water wash (post‑Sudan Black)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in demineralized water three times, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Counterstain with DAPI
steps.instruction: Apply DAPI solution (0.25 µg ml⁻¹) to each section and incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: PBS wash (post‑DAPI)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBS three times, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Store slides at 8 °C in dark
steps.instruction: Place the stained slides at 8 °C and keep them protected from light until imaging.

steps.title: Check tissue requirements and prepare TSA kit components
steps.instruction: Verify that the tissue meets the protocol’s requirements and assemble all components of the Tyramide Signal Amplification Kit before use.
